comparison: One A/B pair per model. Both have open analysis/method/select and exact repair of valid or failed programs, identical relaxed harmless source syntax, identical resources. A shows latest result and complete development leader source. B shows complete source and facts together for latest action, most recent valid method and leader; overlapping roles deduplicate, complete records omitted for capacity retain explicit task IDs. This bundles relevant-program coverage with paired findings, not a clean per-token effect.

data.scope: Future-period conditional count prediction given observed calendar/weather. No evaluation target components or observed future target lags. No final features, labels or scores exposed until all choices freeze.

milestone: At least5%relative final RMSE improvement without equal-date MAE>5%worse than reference. All trajectories, rejections, transport failures and unknown costs stay in denominator.
question: Does pairing the relevant recorded program with its actual execution findings reduce forgotten branches, repeated counterexamples and false one-factor comparisons while supporting creative methods that transfer to a later period?
research_evaluation: Before final metrics manually inspect every proposal and executed source: actual parent/branch fidelity, treatment changes behind attribution, response to counterevidence, representation or question changes beyond parameters. Report repairs/context omissions/repeated failures and counterexamples. Operator assessment is unblinded and interpretive; offline historical checks are not agent discoveries.
scope: One city, one chronological split and one pair per model cannot prove causal demand mechanisms, literature novelty, weather-forecast deployment performance, or stable general research improvement. Original six requirements remain open.
selection: Explicit select or lowest valid development row RMSE at6rounds; ties earliest. Initial reference best of3 on development. Fixed source refit on train+development before final.
source_review: Every fully resolved program manually reviewed before execution. Unchanged frozen worker independently resolves bound source, driver verifies requested and actual source and prediction scores. Static checks are review aids, not sandboxes.
